fish_more_fish_velocid_description:
The Velocid likes to live in dark, shallow waters, similarly colored to the deep space it originated from. It is where it can make the best uses of its bioluminescent body, to light up its surroundings on demand.
The Velocid also likes to run around and find other creatures to befriend them, where it lures them with its beautiful blue marks.
Perhaps, one day, it will try to befriend you.
